title: Player versus Environment
wikitext:
{{TOCright}}
[[Player versus Environment]] ('''PvE''') is a type of gameplay where players interact with computer-controlled opponents. Its counterpart is [[PvP]], where the interaction is with other live players.

PvE in Guild Wars advances characters through a fixed story line, containing many different (and optional) [[quest]]s and [[mission]]s that are given by [[NPC]]s. Players are also immersed into the general environment and landscape of the game, as well as the [[lore]] pertaining to certain [[creature]]s, [[location]]s, NPCs and events.

PvE can be played completely on one's own or with the aid of computer-controlled [[Henchman|henchmen]] and/or [[hero]]es. Alternatively, people may [[Party|team up]] with other live players to advance through the game. 

Guild Wars PvE characters are also called "[[Roleplaying_character|roleplaying characters]]", a term used in the [[character selection screen]].

== Missions and quests ==
[[File:Pve.jpg|thumb|right|An example of fighting in PvE]]
In Guild Wars, the story is advanced primarily through a series of [[Mission|missions]] and [[Quest|quests]] to a pre-determined end. Completing these also progresses one geographically, opening up new [[Explorable_area|areas]] of the [[Campaign|campaign]].

Each campaign ([[Guild_Wars_Prophecies|Prophecies]], [[Guild_Wars_Factions|Factions]], and [[Guild_Wars_Nightfall|Nightfall]]) has a separate, self-contained storyline, though players with multiple campaigns may play all three with a single [[Character|character]]. The [[Expansion|expansion]] pack, [[Guild_Wars_Eye_of_the_North|Eye of the North]], also has a self-contained storyline available to players starting in any one of the campaigns.

Some quests are required to advance the storyline, but [[Secondary_quest|secondary quests]] are entirely optional and may tell side stories, give special items, or add that special depth to the in-game world. Certain quests can also be completed multiple times, and are considered [[List_of_repeatable_quests|repeatable]].

== Other goals and rewards ==
[[File:Hall of Monuments.jpg|thumb|right|The Hall of Monuments.]]
Although the main purpose of PvE is to unfold the story and reach its conclusion, many people enjoy collecting [[Title|titles]], [[Elite_armor|elite armor]], [[Dye|dye]] to customize armor and weapons, and high-quality [[Item_rarity|rare]] or [[Unique_item|unique]] items.  Players who own the Eye of the North expansion may also set up displays in the [[Hall_of_monuments|Hall of Monuments]]. 

To get the [[Gold|money]] or items they desire, some people repeatedly clear ("[[Farm|farm]]") one or more areas, sometimes making an additional character or characters with specialized [[Build|builds]].

[[Unlock]]ing weapon and armor [[Upgrade_component|upgrades]], [[Skill|skills]], and heroes can be done in the normal course of PvE. Some players attempt to do so as completely as possible for both PvE and PvP benefits. For instance, heroes have access to all skills (including [[Elite_skill|elite skills]]) unlocked on an account, which is useful for PvE play.

Various [[optional game modes]], added as a part of [[Guild Wars Reforged]], are also an extra challenge that PvE players can take. Each add additional features, restrictions, or conditions to the way you play.

== Endgame content ==
[[File:HardModeVanquishMap.jpg|thumb|right|Vanquished areas and completed missions in hard mode.]]
Once you complete a campaign, you may still continue playing. Many areas may be played repeatedly, for instance, [[Elite_Mission|elite missions]], [[Competitive_mission|competitive missions]], and [[Challenge_mission|challenge missions]].  

[[Hard_mode|Hard mode]], with more challenging missions and new goals, becomes available for each campaign once you complete it.

== Relationship to PvP ==
*PvE characters may participate in PvP at any time, and there are several low-level [[Arena|arenas]] that are available only to PvE characters.
*All skills (except PvE-only skills from titles and missions) and heroes unlocked in PvE are available to PvP characters.
*PvP equipment for both characters and heroes may be upgraded with any component unlocked on the account.
